notes: 60 pieces, matching the parts list type-by-type. Minifigure parts (helmet, visor, heads, torsos, legs, backpack) are not in the supplied parts list, so they are not recorded.

KEPT AS TWO GROUPS, NOT A REAL PROBLEM: the booklet builds two separate things. One is the Raid VPR ship (b3 to b60). The other is the alien's handheld gun (lego-4360, b1) with its red cone (b2), built on page 2 as a minifigure accessory. The booklet never attaches the gun to the ship; the alien holds it. Adding a join would invent a connection the manual does not show.

Exact stacking (rests_on) for the hull, wings and nose is inferred from isometric drawings and may be approximate. The catalogue gives lego-43713 anti-studs only, so I used it only as an underlying piece.
Pieces held only by pins, clips, bars, hinges or sticker have rests_on [] and are joined through other_joins.
The sticker sheet is one piece (b35); its application to the tile, wings and tail fin is shown as several joins.
The 6541 / 32000 pairs are joined side-by-side by a blue pin, with a black friction pin in the second hole. Wings go onto these pins.
The 1x1 trans-green cones are the ends of the 2L bar pin extensions in step 20. The red/blue light covers sit on the half pins.
